key_agent_trends: UK AI hardware advances with Fractile's $720M Series C for inference chips, backed by sovereign AI fund.
French leadership pushes for 1 GW compute capacity for Mistral AI by 2028 to sustain European frontier models.
Agentic AI funding continues with Berlin's Agent F raising $4M for AI-native ERP and finance agents.
Vertical AI agents attract capital as London's Model ML secures $250M for finance workflows.
European sovereign AI and compute infrastructure remain central themes amid regulation and adoption efforts.

stories.headline: Model ML raises $250 million Series B at $1.5 billion valuation for personal AI agents in finance
stories.what_happened: On 17 November 2026 London-based Model ML raised $250 million in a Series B co-led by General Atlantic and QED Investors at a $1.5 billion valuation. The company builds personal AI agents that run inside banks, consulting firms and asset managers' systems to handle financial models, pitch decks, due diligence and deal analysis. It reports strong growth in ARR and daily active users and claims lower costs via open-source models.
stories.why_it_matters: The large raise signals strong investor confidence in vertical agent platforms that embed deeply into high-value professional workflows rather than generic chatbots.

stories.headline: UK AI chip startup Fractile raises $720 million Series C at ~$7 billion valuation with sovereign AI backing
stories.what_happened: On 11 November 2026, London- and Bristol-based Fractile announced a $720 million Series C led by Thrive Capital, Founders Fund, Lightspeed and Redpoint, valuing the company at approximately $7 billion. The UK Sovereign AI Fund and British Business Bank participated. Fractile develops chips for AI inference to improve speed, energy efficiency and cost.
stories.why_it_matters: The raise, with UK government involvement, advances European sovereign AI hardware capabilities amid competition with US and Asian chipmakers.

stories.headline: French President Macron calls for 1 GW of compute for Mistral AI by end-2028 and €50 billion investment
stories.what_happened: In a video posted on 15 November 2026, Emmanuel Macron stated that Europe must equip itself with 1 gigawatt of computing capacity before the end of 2028 to keep Mistral AI competitive in frontier models, requiring mobilisation of about €50 billion over five years. He emphasised European data centres and reserving capacity for European actors.
stories.why_it_matters: It signals high-level political support for scaling sovereign AI infrastructure and compute for European frontier models amid global competition.

stories.headline: Berlin startup Agent F raises $4 million pre-seed for AI agents automating finance and ERP tasks
stories.what_happened: On 10 November 2026, Berlin-based Agent F raised $4 million in a pre-seed round led by Alpha Edison, with participation from United Founders, Tiny Supercomputer and angels including n8n founder Jan Oberhauser and former SAP CTO Jürgen Müller. The company builds AI agents for accounting, financial controlling and planning in an AI-native ERP for high-growth European companies, with human approval.
stories.why_it_matters: It highlights growing investment in European agentic AI for enterprise back-office automation and sovereign software stacks.
